summary: Pharming Group N.V. furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release dated November 6, 2026, announcing that the U.K. MHRA approved an extension of the marketing authorization for Joenja (leniolisib) to children aged 4 to 11 weighing at least 27 kg with APDS. The approval adds 40 mg and 50 mg twice-daily pediatric dosing and expands the prior U.K. indication covering adults and adolescents 12 and older. Availability under the expanded label is expected in February 2027, with NHS access discussions ongoing. This is a routine regulatory milestone, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or arbitrage angle applies.
